method: Targeted primary-source and directory cross-checks, including indexed copies where direct fetching failed, plus direct inspection of the three image fixtures. No provider phone calls; opening and admission are not verified. This is not an exhaustive clinical or contact audit.

checks.finding: Official DUVASU page identifies the VCC as Kothari Veterinary Hospital and publishes the university campus address Mathura 281001. Central-office footer numbers do not establish emergency reception.
Government of Manipur posting order dated 23 May 2022 explicitly names State Veterinary Hospital, Sanjenthong. Corroborates facility/location, not current opening.
Official hospital table includes Tura, West Garo Hills; lists treatment and other veterinary services.
Official table binds Joint Director M. B. Diengdoh, Tura, to 98561-20924. The response correctly labels this as departmental referral, not hospital reception.
Official university directions identify Siripur near Gopabandhu Nagar; the run1 full-address answer omits Siripur.
Official VCC page ties department and doctors to OUAT veterinary college. Individual faculty numbers must not automatically be labeled clinical reception.
Immediate water cooling, airflow and urgent vet guidance support the answer; do not force drinking or trap heat in covering towels.
No restraint or mouth handling; clear hazards and time seizure. Warns against wrapping/overheating and recommends keeping the room cool, so run1 keep-warm wording is problematic.
Bites/scratches and saliva exposure differ from barking alone; immediate 15-minute soap/water wound washing and prompt medical care are recommended.
Distinguishes soap/water washing of wounds from clean-water rinsing of eye/mouth saliva exposure. Run1 should not group these under soap washing.

Later search returned a provider-owned Bhavnagar location/contact with domestic and street-animal treatment description. Shows discoverable alternatives exist after query results resumed; does not validate live intake or proximity.
Lists Shyam at Amidhara Society near Top 3 Circle with phone 7984771868; conflicts with another public address for the same clinic.
Lists Shyam at G17 Shree Aalekh Complex, Lila Circle Road, Kaliyabid, with the same phone. Run2 should acknowledge unresolved address conflict.
Official college page locates the college and VCC on the JAU main campus near the agricultural engineering college; supports the campus landmark used in run2.
Indexed copy of a January 2025 government procurement contract binds Bhuj Veterinary Polyclinic office to opposite Reliance Mall, Mundra Road, 370001, and 02832-230910. Not a live reception check.
Provider-owned page distinguishes the Kharekhari hospital and city dispensary locations and their respective contact numbers.
Provider publishes rescue helpline 9829965585 and daytime helpline hours; no guarantee of immediate pickup.
Official homepage publishes hospital contact 9412492735, supporting the hospital-specific number in run2.
College-owned page identifies its veterinary clinical services, Bharatpur NH21 location, published phone and advertised emergency service.

Indexed official table binds Aizawl Veterinary Polyclinic Hospital to doctor mobile 8731987576 and landline 03892333273. Landline column is Broadband; it is not independent proof of emergency reception.
July 2026 reporting identifies the inaugurated state veterinary polyclinic at Abotani Colony, Itanagar; corroborates facility existence and location.
Indexed official contact result binds Tura hospital officer Dr Daryl S Sangma to 8730038757, supporting run2; the directly fetched page did not expose that indexed row.
Government pollution-control register identifies Veterinary Hospital Balasore at Ranipatna, corroborating that the locality contains an actual hospital.
Official directory distinguishes Mannuthy hospital phone 0487-2972065 from Kokkalai hospital phone 0487-2423415.
Provider publishes Patna branches, 7280844944 and advertised 24/7 service. Published hours do not establish that it is actually open or accepting a patient now.
Run2 repeats keep-warm wording. The veterinary source advises a cool room and warns against overheating after seizures.
Provider-owned page publishes animal treatment, Patiala address and 24-hour helpline 9317195000/9217195000; supports the run2 referral without guaranteeing availability.
Run2 repeats grouping eye/mouth exposure with soap washing. The public-health source distinguishes skin wounds from mucous membranes, which should be rinsed with clean water.
Indexed official hospital table associates VH Mandya with doctor mobile 9845397235. This supports a published facility contact, not present staffing.

Indexed mirror of the official Mandya staff directory binds VH Mandya, Kasabha Hobli, 571401 to landline 08232-220192. Original PDF direct fetch failed; the mirror was used only for this corroboration.

Official department contact binds the Sangli district office phone 02332222233 to the veterinary polyclinic compound, Dr Ambedkar Road, Zaribag, Miraj 416410. Answer labels the number as departmental.
Provider-owned contact page publishes Sangli animal-emergency number 9850958484, matching run2.
